question: Which company that shares a partner with an institutional investor of NVIDIA also has investments from the same investor?
cypher:
MATCH p=(n0)-[:`PARTNERS_WITH`]-(n1:`Company`)-[:`INVESTED_IN`]-(n2:`InstitutionalInvestor`)-[:`INVESTED_IN`]-(n3:`Company`)
WHERE n0.`name` = $anchor_value
  AND n3.`name` = $target_guard
RETURN DISTINCT coalesce(n3.name, n3.title, n3.ticker, n3.id, n3.uuid, n3.symbol) AS target_value
LIMIT 10

question: Which company competes with the CEO's company of a person mentioned in news articles about NVIDIA Corp.?
cypher:
MATCH p=(n0)-[:`MENTIONED_IN`]-(n1:`NewsArticle`)-[:`MENTIONED_IN`]-(n2:`Person`)-[:`CEO_OF`]-(n3:`Company`)-[:`COMPETES_WITH`]-(n4:`Company`)
WHERE n0.`name` = $anchor_value
  AND n4.`name` = $target_guard
RETURN DISTINCT coalesce(n4.name, n4.title, n4.ticker, n4.id, n4.uuid, n4.symbol) AS target_value
LIMIT 10
